title: Windows TCP Tuning (Advanced)
name: optimize-network-settings
description: Advanced TCP settings that vary by connection. Use the FiveM Hitreg Diagnostics entry to check your actual connection first.
deepDescription:
ADVANCED WINDOWS TCP PROFILE
Changes Windows TCP heuristics, congestion control, RSS, ECN, timestamps, TCP Fast Open, and the custom initial congestion window. The effects depend on your driver, router, ISP, and Windows version. A restart may be needed.

NO HITREG PROMISE
This does not change FiveM server tick rate, game netcode, weapon registration, or the route to a particular server. Windows TCP settings cannot guarantee better hit registration or lower ping. Compare your real in-game packet loss and latency before and after applying.

UNDO
Undo restores generic Windows TCP defaults. If you had custom TCP settings, record them first; this older profile does not preserve each previous TCP value. For a no-change connection report, use Hitreg Diagnostics (FiveM).
